summary.intent: Monitor a PR for automated reviews from CodeRabbit and GitHub Copilot, then resolve all review comments by implementing fixes and pushing them.
summary.outcome: Successfully waited for CodeRabbit's review (after a quota cooldown), implemented two valid fixes in E2E test files, committed/pushed, and resolved all review threads.

repo: CodeRabbit has a per-quota cooldown that can delay reviews by ~15-20 minutes after a previous review cycle.
The project uses pnpm with a typecheck script for E2E test files under tests/web-e2e.
PR review threads are resolved via GitHub GraphQL API (resolveReviewThread mutation); replies use REST API with integer in_reply_to field using --field not -f.

code.finding: Was missing a required faro_enabled: true field in the baseline fixture — flagged by CodeRabbit and confirmed by grep showing the field is part of the expected schema.
Had a valid improvement identified by CodeRabbit; fix was applied and type-checked successfully before commit.

workflow: Background polling loops (wait N min then check) create compounding poll tasks that can clutter context; a single disciplined poll interval is cleaner.
When review bots are on quota cooldown, direct checks return stale results — checking the quota reset time estimate is more reliable than repeated polling.
Committing with specific file paths (not git add -A) is the correct approach per the fixture guard fix pattern established earlier in the session.

friction: CodeRabbit quota cooldown caused ~20+ minutes of waiting with no actionable progress, requiring many redundant polling attempts.
Multiple overlapping background poll tasks were spawned, making it difficult to track which results were current.
Copilot's second review never arrived despite being requested, leaving uncertainty about whether the review request was successfully triggered.
GraphQL vs REST API distinction for PR comments (reply via REST, resolve via GraphQL) added friction when looking up correct IDs.
open_items: Copilot's second review was requested but never arrived — unclear if the request succeeded or if Copilot needs to be re-invited.
No E2E tests were run (only typecheck) after the CodeRabbit fixes — full playwright test run was skipped.
